clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in me by section 5317 of tide 5 of  
the United States Code, and as President of the United States of  
America, section 2 of Executive Order No. 11861 of May 21, 1975, as  
amended, placing certain positions in level V  of the Executive Schedule,  
is further amended by deleting “(1).  Principal Deputy Assistant  
Secretary of Defense (Comptroller), Department of Defense.” and  
inserting in lieu thereof “(1)  Defense Representative, Iran, Department  
of Defense.”
